name: compass-diffmap
description: Compass: mapa navegable de repositorios y diffs (DiffMap) con zoom semántico

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @compass/core build && pnpm --filter @compass/web build && pnpm --filter @compass/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @compass/web exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @compass/core exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @compass/cli exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
